tools.name: add_scene_events
tools.summary: Apply an official serialized GDevelopEventPayload to add or change scene events.

generatedEvents.description: Official serialized gd.EventsList JSON consumed by applyEventsChanges.

generatedEventsContract.representation: changes[].generatedEvents is a JSON string whose decoded value is an array serialized by GDevelop gd.EventsList.

discoverInstructions.parameterRule: Query every needed action, condition, and expression. Use returned parameters in their exact array order, including code-only parameters. Do not infer a type, expression spelling, or parameter order.

officialCreateActionExample.rule: generatedEvents contains JSON.stringify(decodedGeneratedEvents), not an object wrapper.

generatedEventsContract.conditionInversion: Set condition.type.inverted to true only for an inverted condition; otherwise omit it or use false.
generatedEventsContract.validation: The pinned official GDevelop unserializer and event applier are authoritative. null generatedEvents does not request generation and cannot insert events.

locallyConstructedChangeDefaults.rule: These fields describe official generator diagnostics. When constructing from verified local metadata instead of an official generation response, use these neutral values; never claim true validation flags.

tools.name: create_scene

tools.name: list_prefabs

tools.name: inspect_prefab
tools.summary: Inspect one project EventsBasedObject definition through official GDevelop getters.

tools.name: inspect_scene_properties_layers_effects
tools.summary: Read scene properties, layers, and effects. Use list_project_objects to read scene object groups and their members.

tools.name: change_scene_properties_layers_effects_groups
tools.summary: Change scene properties, layers, effects, and scene object groups. Use list_project_objects before and after this call to read group membership.

tools.name: add_or_edit_variable
tools.summary: Create, edit, or delete batches of global, scene, object, or object-group variables.

tools.name: inspect_variables
tools.summary: Read variables through the pinned official GDevelop function. Object and group scopes use object_name; in GDevelop 5.6.276 a group inspection returns the variables of its first member.

variable_scope.description: For object and group scopes, object_name selects either an object or an object group using the official resolver.

scene_name.description: Required for scene scope. For object or group scope, include it to resolve the scene context; omit it to inspect only global objects or groups.

object_name.description: Required for object or group scope. This is the object name or object-group name.

variable_names_or_paths.description: Optional variable names or nested paths. When omitted or empty, the official function returns all variables in the resolved container.
